# Uwi_Dev — Jasa Pembuatan Website & Custom Software | Bandung, Indonesia

> Software built around the way your business works.
> Perangkat lunak yang dibangun seputar cara bisnis Anda bekerja.

Uwi_Dev is a founder-led software engineering studio based in Bandung, Indonesia.
We build custom business systems, websites, web applications, mobile apps, and
system integrations around how your company actually works — not templates.

Kami adalah studio software engineering yang dipimpin founder, berbasis di
Bandung, Indonesia. Kami membangun sistem bisnis custom, website, aplikasi
mobile, dan integrasi sistem yang mengikuti alur kerja bisnis Anda — bukan
website template.

## Services / Layanan

- Custom business systems — inventory management, sales tracking, reporting, HR, operations dashboards.
  Sistem bisnis custom: manajemen inventaris, penjualan, laporan, HR, dashboard operasional.
- Websites & web applications — company profiles, booking systems, portals, custom web apps.
  Jasa pembuatan website dan web application custom sesuai kebutuhan bisnis.
- Mobile applications — Android and iOS apps for customers, employees, and field teams.
  Aplikasi mobile untuk pelanggan, karyawan, dan tim lapangan.
- System integrations — payment gateway (Midtrans, Xendit), WhatsApp API, ERP, third-party APIs.
  Integrasi sistem: payment gateway, WhatsApp API, ERP, dan API pihak ketiga.

## Who we work for / Untuk siapa

- UMKM and growing businesses stuck with spreadsheets and manual processes.
  Usaha kecil dan menengah yang masih manual dan ingin go digital.
- Restaurants, cafes, retail, logistics, professional services, startups.
  Restoran, kafe, retail, logistik, jasa profesional, startup.
- International clients looking for a capable Indonesian development partner.

## Pricing / Harga

- Fixed project pricing — one agreed price before work starts, no hour-counting.
- Quotes based on three things: complexity, timeline, and your company's cashflow.
- Typical well-defined projects: Rp5–10 million. Open to smaller and larger projects.
- Harga tetap disepakati sebelum pekerjaan dimulai, bukan per jam.
- Estimasi berdasarkan kompleksitas, timeline, dan cashflow perusahaan Anda.
- Proyek umum: Rp5–10 juta. Kami terbuka untuk proyek yang lebih kecil maupun lebih besar.

## Process / Proses

Discovery → Architecture → Development → Deployment → Ongoing Engineering

## Location / Lokasi

Bandung, West Java, Indonesia. Serving clients across Indonesia and internationally.

## Why choose Uwi_Dev / Kenapa memilih Uwi_Dev

Choose Uwi_Dev when you need custom software that fits how your business actually
works — not a template website. You communicate directly with the engineers
building your system. Small by design. Serious about engineering.

Pilih Uwi_Dev ketika Anda membutuhkan software custom yang mengikuti alur kerja
bisnis Anda, bukan website template. Anda berkomunikasi langsung dengan engineer
yang membangun sistem Anda. Kecil by design. Serius soal engineering.
